description: This file implements a role for integrating libdbus with the libwebsockets event loop, managing DBus watches, timeouts, and connection handling within the libwebsockets framework. It includes functions for creating shadow WSIs for DBus file descriptors, managing their lifecycle, and handling DBus events in the context of libwebsockets.

methods.name: struct:lws * __lws_shadow_wsi(struct lws_dbus_ctx * ctx,DBusWatch * w,int fd,int create_ok)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a lightweight shadow wsi associated with a DBus file descriptor, creating a new wsi if necessary and permitted.

methods.name: int __lws_shadow_wsi_destroy(struct lws_dbus_ctx * ctx,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Destroys a shadow wsi associated with a DBus watch, removing it from the poll fd set and freeing its resources.

methods.name: void handle_dispatch_status(DBusConnection * c,DBusDispatchStatus s,void * data)
methods.description: Handles changes in the dispatch status of the DBus connection, primarily for logging.

methods.name: dbus_bool_t lws_dbus_add_watch(DBusWatch * w,void * data)
methods.description: Adds a DBus watch to the libwebsockets event loop, creating or retrieving a shadow wsi and configuring poll events.

methods.name: int __check_destroy_shadow_wsi(struct lws_dbus_ctx * ctx,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Checks if a shadow wsi should be destroyed based on the current watch state and connection status.

methods.name: void lws_dbus_remove_watch(DBusWatch * w,void * data)
methods.description: Removes a DBus watch from the event loop, clearing associated poll events on shadow WSIs.

methods.name: void lws_dbus_toggle_watch(DBusWatch * w,void * data)
methods.description: Enables or disables a DBus watch based on its current state.

methods.name: void lws_dbus_sul_cb(lws_sorted_usec_list_t * sul)
methods.description: Callback for handling scheduled timers related to DBus events.

methods.name: dbus_bool_t lws_dbus_add_timeout(DBusTimeout * t,void * data)
methods.description: Adds a DBus timeout to the event loop, scheduling a callback after the specified interval.

methods.name: void lws_dbus_remove_timeout(DBusTimeout * t,void * data)
methods.description: Removes a DBus timeout from the event loop.

methods.name: void lws_dbus_toggle_timeout(DBusTimeout * t,void * data)
methods.description: Enables or disables a DBus timeout based on its enabled state.

methods.name: int lws_dbus_connection_setup(struct lws_dbus_ctx * ctx,DBusConnection * conn,lws_dbus_closing_t cb_closing)
methods.description: Sets up a DBus connection within the libwebsockets context, establishing watch and timeout functions.

methods.name: DBusServer * lws_dbus_server_listen(struct lws_dbus_ctx * ctx,const char * ads,DBusError * e,DBusNewConnectionFunction new_conn)
methods.description: Creates and configures a DBus server, integrating it with the libwebsockets event loop.

methods.name: int rops_handle_POLLIN_dbus(struct lws_context_per_thread * pt,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd)
methods.description: Handles POLLIN and POLLOUT events on a shadow wsi associated with a DBus watch.

methods.name: int rops_pt_init_destroy_dbus(struct lws_context * context,const struct lws_context_creation_info * info,struct lws_context_per_thread * pt,int destroy)
methods.description: Initializes or destroys DBus-related per-thread resources within the libwebsockets context.
